queries:
WITH combo AS (
  SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.tradekind AS tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  WHERE s.optvolrt IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_opt) AS base FROM combo
),
dev AS (
  SELECT c.transref, c.tradekind, c.avg_opt, c.avg_opt - b.base AS deviation
  FROM combo c CROSS JOIN baseline b
),
typeavg AS (
  SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS avg_dev FROM dev GROUP BY tradekind
),
kept AS (
  SELECT d.tradekind, d.avg_opt, d.deviation, d.deviation - ta.avg_dev AS excess
  FROM dev d JOIN typeavg ta ON d.tradekind = ta.tradekind
  WHERE d.deviation > ta.avg_dev
)
SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_opt) AS mean_avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS mean_deviation, AVG(excess) AS mean_excess
FROM kept
GROUP BY tradekind;
WITH combo AS (
  SELECT tradekind, posspan, AVG(acctbal) AS avg_bal
  FROM trader
  GROUP BY tradekind, posspan
)
SELECT tradekind, posspan, avg_bal
FROM combo
WHERE avg_bal > (SELECT AVG(avg_bal) FROM combo WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL);
SELECT s.corpeventprx, s.eventannotm
FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
JOIN investigationdetails i ON i.sentref = s.sentreg
GROUP BY s.corpeventprx, s.eventannotm
HAVING AVG(s.optvolrt) > (
  SELECT AVG(s2.optvolrt)
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s2
  JOIN investigationdetails i2 ON i2.sentref = s2.sentreg
);
WITH combo AS (
  SELECT corpeventprx, eventannotm, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_opt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx, eventannotm
  HAVING AVG(optvolrt) IS NOT NULL
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_opt) AS base_avg, COUNT(*) AS total_combos FROM combo
)
SELECT c.corpeventprx,
       COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
       AVG(c.avg_opt) AS type_avg,
       b.base_avg AS baseline_avg,
       AVG(c.avg_opt) - b.base_avg AS diff_from_baseline
FROM combo c
CROSS JOIN baseline b
GROUP BY c.corpeventprx;
